notes: Ran into the same unbreakable IP Block roughly forty times at 0-1 credits, piling up tags instead of building economy or finding a breaker; the corp scored out unopposed.
Sensible Jinteki play that scored House of Knives behind ice and used a Fetal AI remote as a trap for the flatline; credits ran very thin for much of the game.

Repeatedly ran the same R&D top card and an HQ full of operations, never contested the advancing remote that scored two GFIs and Atlas, and never trashed the economy assets; it ended up clicking for credits while tagged.
Scored steadily in an Ansel-protected remote with Seamless Launch and kept good economy; minor oddities include installing duplicate unique Spin Doctor and Rashida, which trashed the earlier copies.
Won through good HQ/R&D pressure with Aumakua and Legwork, but kept taking Liza tags every run and let the corp trash PAD Tap and Drug Dealer repeatedly; tag management was poor.

Left R&D behind only a non-ETR Drafter all game and put early agendas behind a single breakable Magnet; late it clicked for credits for four turns at 14-23 credits while discarding instead of icing R&D, which lost to an R&D steal.
Efficient Geist play: it stole from open R&D early, broke Fairchild into HQ, and took the naked remote for the win; there were a couple of passive credit turns while R&D was still soft.
Ran open R&D four times per turn, re-accessing the same top card, and never installed anything; it never ran the advancing remote where the corp scored two GFIs.

Biotic Labor was spent on clicking for credits, and HQ stayed behind a single IP Block the runner broke every turn, so the runner stole three agendas from HQ; Ultraviolet Clearance on the last turn drew the losing agenda into an unprotected HQ.
Won with fast install-and-score turns using Jeeves clicks, but it played Ark Lockdown for nothing, used Biotic Labor to click for credits, and left Vitruvius in a naked remote overnight early on.
Solid remote-scoring game behind Loki and Magnet with reasonable economy; there were a few idle credit clicks and a slightly slow pace.

Good pressure with Paperclip and Black Orchestra stole from the remote and R&D for the win; it left four tags on for several turns while the corp trashed resources and made a few pointless Archives runs.

Left an advanced GFI behind unrezzed ice that it did not rez, and Audacity binned two Megaprix into an open Archives for free steals; at the end it installed the final agenda behind a breakable Magnet while the runner was at match point.
Repeated R&D and HQ runs re-seeing the same cards, then clicked for credits up to 28 for four turns while the corp advanced and scored two remotes without ever being contested.
Built a working Lat rig and won by stealing from HQ and Archives, but it made several empty Archives runs and took heavy net damage from Mlinzi and Loki that a better line would have avoided.

Clicked for credits nearly every turn at 10-19 credits while discarding, never built a remote, and advanced a GFI in a naked server; Drafter installs put a GFI and then Luminal into unprotected remotes that were stolen.

Eventually won through steady R&D pressure, but it left Hard-Hitting News tags on for many turns so the corp kept trashing its resources, and it made many empty Archives runs and a pointless I've Had Worse.
Used Mushin No Shin to put agendas into naked remotes that were stolen for free, then installed Fetal AI in a new naked remote while the runner sat at 5 points, handing over the win.
Lost an early Luminal after Mining Accident left it unable to rez, then recovered with Assembly Lines economy and scored four agendas behind Border Control and Hagen.

Spent the early turns running open R&D three or four times a turn and re-seeing the same card, then clicked for credits up to 22 while the corp scored Vitruvius and later Efficiency Committee mostly uncontested.
